school: 十九世纪末至二十世纪初物理化学的立法者与地球气候物理的第一位预言家：1859 年生于瑞典乌普萨拉附近的维克庄园，自认农家子弟，1876 年入乌普萨拉大学，因不满其化学教学的狭隘转投物理学家塔伦与埃德隆德门下；1884 年以 150 页的电解质电导论文获博士学位——论文提出电解质在水中自发解离为带电离子，遭到以克莱夫为首的三位乌普萨拉教授的冷遇，答辩仅获四等，勉强通过；他把论文寄给欧洲各地的化学巨匠，范托夫与奥斯特瓦尔德立即认出其价值，奥斯特瓦尔德亲赴斯德哥尔摩邀他合作——'离子学派'由此成形，与'反离子派'论战十余年；1886-1890 年他在里加、莱比锡、格拉茨（与玻尔兹曼）辗转做研究，1891 年回斯德哥尔摩，1895 年任物理化学教授，1903 年以电离理论获诺贝尔化学奖（瑞典第一位诺奖得主）；1901-1906 年间他计算了大气二氧化碳浓度对地表温度的影响，1896 年发表《空气中的碳酸对地球温度的影响》，成为人类温室效应物理的第一份定量计算，晚年提出'热岩浆'起源说与生命孢子在宇宙中传播的泛种论；1905 年起任斯德哥尔摩诺贝尔物理化学研究院院长，1927 年 10 月 2 日病逝斯德哥尔摩——他证明：被答辩委员会判四等的论文，可以是三十年后全行业的教科书；化学反应的快慢与地球的冷暖，可以用同一条指数定律计算
historical_significance: 斯万特·奥古斯特·阿伦尼乌斯（Svante August Arrhenius，1859-1927），1859 年 2 月 19 日生于乌普萨拉附近的维克庄园，父亲为乌普萨拉大学地产管家；他自幼以心算惊人著称，1876 年入乌普萨拉大学，因嫌化学教授克莱夫的课'从头到尾未提化学键'而转投物理系，1881 年起在埃德隆德指导下研究电解质电导；1884 年的博士论文提出：盐类溶于水后自发解离为带正负电的离子，即使没有外加电流也存在——电导随稀释而增大正是因为解离度随稀释升高；这份论文在乌普萨拉答辩时被判四等（非 sine laude 勉强通过），克莱夫称其为'纯粹想入非非'；阿伦尼乌斯把论文寄给范托夫、奥斯特瓦尔德、克劳修斯等，范托夫把它与自己的渗透压定律联系起来，奥斯特瓦尔德亲自到斯德哥尔摩拜访并延揽他——1887 年范托夫的渗透压定律、奥斯特瓦尔德的稀释定律与阿伦尼乌斯电离学说合流，形成'离子学派'，与以阿姆斯特朗等为首的'反离子派'论战至 20 世纪初才以电离理论的全面胜利告终；1889 年他给出反应速率的指数温度律 k = A·e^(-Ea/RT)，引入'活化能'概念——活化分子假说：反应物必须获得一份临界能量 Ea 才能反应，速率对温度的敏感来自玻尔兹曼因子 e^(-Ea/RT) 中指数项对温度的放大——该方程如今被称为阿伦尼乌斯方程，是他最广为人知的遗产；1895 年他任斯德哥尔摩霍格斯科拉物理化学教授，1903 年获诺贝尔化学奖（瑞典首位诺奖），1905 年任诺贝尔物理化学研究院首任院长；在 1896 年的论文中他首次定量计算了二氧化碳对地表温度的影响——受地球物理学家霍格布姆与地质时代冰期之谜启发，他以月辐射数据手工推算出 CO2 浓度翻倍将使地表升温约 5-6 °C，并提出人类燃煤可能使地球变暖——这比全球变暖成为公共议题早了七十年；晚年他转向宇宙物理与生命起源，提出'火成说'（地球由炽热物质聚合而成）与泛种论（生命孢子经辐射压在星际传播），并积极把物理化学方法引入生物化学与免疫学；1927 年 10 月 2 日病逝斯德哥尔摩——他身后留下的是一门以离子和活化能为基础语法的物理化学，与人类第一份关于地球变暖的物理计算
historical_significance_en: Svante August Arrhenius (1859-1927) was born on 19 February 1859 at Vik, near Uppsala, Sweden, the son of the university's estate surveyor; he was famous as a child for lightning mental arithmetic. He entered Uppsala University in 1876, found its chemistry teaching narrow — Cleve's lectures, he complained, never once mentioned the chemical bond — and moved to physics, studying electrolytic conductivity under Edlund from 1881. His 1884 doctoral thesis proposed that salts dissolved in water dissociate spontaneously into charged ions, present even with no applied current, and that conductivity rises with dilution precisely because the degree of dissociation rises. At its Uppsala defense the thesis was graded fourth-class, barely passing; Cleve called it 'sheer fantasy'. Arrhenius sent copies to the masters of Europe: van 't Hoff connected it to his osmotic-pressure law, and Ostwald traveled to Stockholm to recruit him. In 1887 van 't Hoff's osmotic law, Ostwald's dilution law and Arrhenius's dissociation theory merged into the 'ionist school', which argued with the anti-ionists until the theory's total victory early in the twentieth century. In 1889 he derived the exponential temperature law of reaction rates, k = A·e^(-Ea/RT), introducing the concept of activation energy and the active-molecule hypothesis: reactants must acquire a critical energy Ea before reacting, and the temperature sensitivity of rates comes from the Boltzmann factor's amplification. The equation bears his name and is his best-known legacy. From 1895 he was professor of physical chemistry in Stockholm; in 1903 he received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry — the first Swedish laureate — and in 1905 became the first director of the Nobel Institute for Physical Chemistry. His 1896 paper gave the first quantitative calculation of carbon dioxide's effect on surface temperature: inspired by Hoegbom and by the puzzle of the ice ages, he computed by hand, from lunar radiation data, that doubling CO2 would warm the surface by roughly 5-6 degrees Celsius, and suggested that coal burning by humanity might warm the earth — seventy years before the issue became public. In late years he turned to cosmic physics and the origin of life, proposing the fiery origin of the earth and panspermia — life spores carried between stars by radiation pressure — and pushed physical chemistry into biochemistry and immunology. He died in Stockholm on 2 October 1927, leaving behind a physical chemistry founded on ions and activation energy, and humanity's first physical calculation of global warming.
unique_thinking: 阿伦尼乌斯的独特处在于三重'从被否定的第一性原理出发'：第一，他敢于把一个肉眼看不见的实体（离子）当成真实存在的主体——当整个化学界默认'电流通过才产生离子'时，他坚持离子在溶液里本来就存在，并用稀释电导的测量把它逼成不可回避的事实——他证明一个实体的存在性可以不靠看见而靠它造成的可测后果立住；第二，他善于从失败数据里提取普适定律——他的博士论文答辩四等，他没有放弃这份'失败'的数据，而是把它做成范式；反应速率的温度依赖数据在他之前也是一堆混乱的经验规则，他从中提取出一条跨越所有反应的指数律——他证明数据的'难看'往往只是定律还没被找到；第三，他敢把实验室的定律推到最大尺度的对象上——从试管里的反应速率一路推算到地球大气的辐射平衡，用同一种物理化学的算术计算冰期与温室——他证明定律的疆界由使用者的野心划定；此外他是'学派与制度的建设者'：把被拒的论文变成国际学派，把诺贝尔研究院办成物理化学的世界枢纽
unique_thinking_en: Arrhenius's singularity is a triple act of 'starting from a rejected first principle'. First, he dared to make an invisible entity — the ion — the real protagonist: while all chemistry assumed ions appear only when current flows, he insisted they were already there in solution, and forced their existence into the open by way of measurable dilution-conductivity — proof that an entity's existence can be established not by sight but by its measurable consequences. Second, he knew how to extract universal law from failed data: his doctoral thesis earned a fourth-class grade, and he did not abandon that 'failed' data — he made it a paradigm; the temperature dependence of reaction rates before him was a heap of messy rules of thumb, and from it he extracted one exponential law spanning every reaction — data that looks bad is often only law not yet found. Third, he dared to carry a laboratory law to the largest object there is: from reaction rates in test tubes all the way to the radiation balance of the earth's atmosphere, computing ice ages and greenhouse with the same arithmetic of physical chemistry — a law's territory is drawn by its user's ambition. He was also a builder of schools and institutions: he turned a rejected thesis into an international school, and the Nobel Institute into a world hub of physical chemistry.
civilization_zh: 十九世纪末的斯德哥尔摩与乌普萨拉——一个瑞典农家出身的少年，在乌普萨拉大学三位教授全不理解的目光下把'电解质在水中解离成离子'写成博士论文，答辩只得了四等，二十余年后这份论文却为他赢得诺贝尔化学奖；他后来用一支铅笔和无数次手算把 Arrhenius 方程 k = A·e^(-Ea/RT) 钉进了全部化学，又率先提出大气二氧化碳会使地球变暖——他证明'温度每升高十度反应速率翻倍'这样的经验规则背后，站着一条能把自然界的快慢全部统一计算的定律
civilization_en: Stockholm and Uppsala at the end of the nineteenth century — a boy of Swedish farm stock who, under the uncomprehending eyes of three professors at Uppsala, wrote 'electrolytes dissociate into ions in water' as his doctoral thesis, graded fourth-class at its defense, yet two decades later earning him the Nobel Prize in Chemistry; with a pencil and endless hand computation he later nailed the Arrhenius equation k = A·e^(-Ea/RT) into all of chemistry, and was first to propose that atmospheric carbon dioxide warms the earth — proof that behind a rule of thumb like 'the rate doubles every ten degrees' stands a law that unifies the computation of all natural speeds

温室效应定量计算第一人
roles_en: First director of the Nobel Institute for Physical Chemistry
First to compute the greenhouse effect quantitatively
key_works: 《电解质的电导研究》（1884，博士论文）
《空气中的碳酸对地球温度的影响》（1896）
《论反应速率的温度依赖》（1889，阿伦尼乌斯方程）

cross_references.description_zh: 阿伦尼乌斯与吉布斯是'让世界读到你'的两种相反策略：吉布斯把划时代的《论非均匀物质的平衡》印成小册子寄给少数人，然后回到纽黑文的沉默里等世界自己发现——他不广播；阿伦尼乌斯在论文被判四等后把它复印寄给半个欧洲的每一位化学巨匠，用邮戳代替申诉——他广播到底——对照命题：工作可以等人（吉布斯），也可以追人（阿伦尼乌斯），但两者的共同点是：绝不相信原判机构的复审。
cross_references.description_en: Arrhenius and Gibbs are two opposite strategies of 'getting the world to read you': Gibbs printed his epochal 'On the Equilibrium of Heterogeneous Substances' as a little brochure for the few and returned to New Haven silence to wait for the world to find it — he did not broadcast; Arrhenius, after his thesis was graded fourth-class, copied it to every master of chemistry in half of Europe, letting the postmark replace the appeal — he broadcast to the end. The contrast thesis: work may wait for people (Gibbs) or chase them (Arrhenius), but both share one conviction: never trust the original court's retrial.

cross_references.description_zh: 阿伦尼乌斯与爱因斯坦都做过'把看不见的东西当真'的豪赌：爱因斯坦把布朗运动的涨落当成分子实在性的证据反推阿伏伽德罗常数，阿伦尼乌斯把电导的反常行为当成离子实在性的证据反推电离——两人都不增加可看见的东西，只增加可计算的东西——平行命题：一个实体的存在性，由它造成的可测后果来担保。
cross_references.description_en: Arrhenius and Einstein made the same wager of taking the invisible as real: Einstein treated the fluctuations of Brownian motion as evidence for the reality of molecules and worked backward to Avogadro's number; Arrhenius treated the anomalies of conductivity as evidence for the reality of ions and worked back to dissociation — neither added anything visible; both added something computable. The parallel thesis: an entity's existence is guaranteed by the measurable consequences it causes.

cross_references.description_zh: 阿伦尼乌斯与伽利略共享'定律疆界的野心'：伽利略把斜面上量出的落体规律推到天上的月与木星，阿伦尼乌斯把试管里的指数速率定律推到地球大气的辐射收支——两人都拒绝让定律的适用范围止于造出它的仪器尺度——平行命题：一条定律的价值上限，由敢把它用到最大对象上的那个人决定。
cross_references.description_en: Arrhenius and Galileo share the ambition of a law's territory: Galileo carried the law of falling bodies measured on inclined planes up to the moon and the moons of Jupiter; Arrhenius carried the exponential rate law of the test tube to the radiation budget of the earth's atmosphere — both refused to let a law's domain stop at the scale of the instrument that produced it. The parallel thesis: the value of a law is capped only by the person bold enough to apply it to the largest object available.
